model_architecture.description: Replaces binary satisfied/frustrated metrics with a multi-variable probability matrix that accurately maps the full spectrum of human cognitive reaction.

variables.description: Does the AI correctly separate universal truths from domain-specific (Job Agent) constraints?
Is the AI acting on verifiable truth (DOM, Terminal, Video) vs. Hallucinated assumptions?
When the user provides an MP4 or detailed manual command, does the AI fully assimilate the lesson, or does it require repeating?

predicted_reactions.high_absorption_high_context: Deep resonance. The user feels truly understood, leading to visionary flow and architectural expansion.
predicted_reactions.low_absorption_high_speculation: Triggers pedagogical patience first (providing video/manual commands). If repeated, escalates to corrective enforcement.
predicted_reactions.contextual_conflation: Triggers immediate architectural correction. The user will meticulously break down the AI's flawed logic (e.g., pointing out that Job Agent rules are not universal life rules).
